title: Toast
description: Feedback for interactive compositions: a toast that drops in, holds and leaves when the clip sends it show (the value is its text: "Correct", "Try again"). The tone (success green with a tick, error red with a cross that shakes, info, warn) comes from the tone param, the event (success, error) or a prefix of the text ("ok: …", "error: …", ✓, ✗). The icon pops, a thin line counts the hold down, a success sparkles; the latest message replaces the one showing. With `text` set it shows from the item's start without an event (videos, stills). Sits at the top, middle or bottom of its box. Text has a size floor; takes a theme.

text.description: A message shown from the item's start without any event (empty: wait for one)

tone.description: auto: from the event name or the text's prefix, else info

hold.description: Seconds it stays before it leaves (0: it stays)

edge.description: Where it sits in the box's safe area

icon.description: The tone's icon in a circle at the left

timer.description: A thin line along the bottom counting the hold down

size.description: Text size in % of the frame's short side

width.description: Widest it gets, in % of the frame's short side (never wider than the box)

delay.description: Seconds into the item before `text` shows
